name: Checkbox, radio and switch
summary: Native checkboxes, radios and switches drawn to match the theme, each wrapped in a label so the whole row is the click target.
description: Use checkboxes for independent yes or no choices, radios for one choice from a short list, and a switch for a setting that takes effect at once. For rich tiles with a title, text or price, use choice cards.

states.description: Filled with the accent and marked.
A DOM property only (not an attribute), set from script: shows a dash for a mixed state.
The control and its row are dimmed and cannot be changed.
A danger border on an unchecked control, as does :user-invalid on a required one.
Announces a .v-switch as on or off rather than checked.

keyboard.action: Moves to a checkbox or switch, or to the checked radio of a group.
Toggles a checkbox or switch, or checks the focused radio.
Moves the choice between radios in the same group.

a11y: The controls stay native inputs, so keyboard, form and label behaviour are the browser's own.
Wrap the control and its text in <label class="v-choice"> so the text names the control and the whole row is clickable.
Put a group of choices in a <fieldset> with a <legend> so the question is read with each option.
Use role="switch" only for settings that apply at once; in a form that is submitted, a checkbox is clearer.
